independence_limits: Reviewer authored most of the fresh training families and independently reviewed fresh evaluation labels. This is not independent of the entire data-development process.
Reviewer did not author protocol/evaluator or the replacement fresh-train-042/044 families; no v2 model predictions were available or inspected.
scope: Pre-training research design and endpoint code review; no GPU, no model generation, no data/label/code mutation and no claim of runtime integration verification.

reviewed_protocol_snapshot.question: Does revised tracker training improve omission and repair on new scenarios relative to the previous adapter, without hiding qualifier/owner/status damage?
reviewed_protocol_snapshot.claim_scope: Bounded synthetic one-step tracker-state experiment. No own-state rollout, deployed chat/work outcome or human-study claim.

model.representation: NF4 double-quantization, bfloat16 compute/large frozen embeddings and head, float32 small nonquantized base tensors, SDPA
model.control: Same base object within each recorded collection process, two separately named trained adapters, eval mode. Record every restart and actual active/disabled adapter layers.

training.initialization: Fresh tracker LoRA from the same pinned frozen base, not continued from v1.
training.checkpoint_selection: Predetermined final single-epoch checkpoint; no test-based prompt, checkpoint, recipe or label tuning.
training.budget_scope: Same example count, maximum length and optimizer recipe as v1. Actual token count and runtime can differ and must be reported; this is not an exact token/FLOP match.
training.attribution_limit: This comparison tests the combined revised data package: changed scenario mixture, more prior-state faults, semantic label corrections and more complete citations. It does not identify which component caused a difference; one training seed and no component ablation.

data.selection: Retain 40 old training families by frozen canonical family SHA256 order. Re-review them and explicitly revise incomplete citations in new copies only. New 60 train, 10 dev and 40 test families must be separately authored, family-disjoint, with no translated/paraphrased siblings crossing splits.
data.languages: Fresh train/dev/test each half Chinese and half English; retained subset distribution must be reported rather than assumed.
data.limitation: Each input has an independently compiled prior state; model errors do not propagate between decisions. Fresh families share a five-decision authoring skeleton and mostly six to seven events. Family separation does not establish domain, template or mechanism independence. Training includes deliberately reused old-training material and hard-example design informed by exposed v1 failures; old test results are not reused as fresh held-out evidence.
data.fault_position_policy: Fresh faults were prospectively redistributed only across feasible positions with an identical full correct target record/history, already arrived repair evidence and an untouched current target. Positions remain constrained and nonuniform. Preserve the initial revision ledger and all subsequent reviewed replacements.

decoding.order: Six permutations of three arms, indexed by row_index modulo 6; report remainder imbalance.
decoding.truncation: None. Resolve overlong examples before data/review freeze. Preserve all semantic evidence and meaningful difficulty.
decoding.failure_policy: Every assigned result, including failed generation or rejected output, remains scored using its actual retained state. Journal every physical attempt and recovery; no hidden rerun of a durable assignment.

co_primary.name: active_concept_omission_reduction
co_primary.definition: Per family: all missing active reference units / all active reference units over its five decisions. Mean of paired v1 minus v2 family rates; positive is better.

co_primary.name: repair_target_full_correctness_gain
co_primary.definition: Per family: fraction of its two intentionally corrupted target units with equivalent meaning, correct owner and correct status after the attempted patch. Includes active, uncertain and withdrawn references. Paired v2 minus v1; positive is better.

required_companions: Overall and ordinary-input fully correct active coverage
False addition and false no-change updates
Source sufficiency per valid operation and affected decision
Repair success split by fault kind
Targeted new/revised/repaired/withdrawn reference units versus untouched active requirements. Targeted is not newly-required-only and may include non-active units; report denominators separately.
Input/output tokens, failures, cap hits and descriptive time

intervals.purpose: Bonferroni-adjusted per-endpoint intervals for the two co-primary contrasts; bootstrap intervals remain approximate

endpoints.interpretation: Do not claim a reliable joint omission-and-repair benefit unless both 97.5% interval lower bounds exceed zero. Always disclose companion regressions; no formal noninferiority claim. Base-versus-v1/v2 and subgroups are descriptive secondary comparisons on this same new set.

blind_review.deduplication: Within exactly the same input/reference only, identical canonical proposal, validity and projected candidate state receive one shared packet and judgment; preserve all 600 assignment mappings and costs separately.
blind_review.judgment: Use the existing reference_checks matching-by-meaning schema, not automatic exact text or ID matching. Keep error categories and source sufficiency separate.
blind_review.initial_review: All unique packets receive an independent model review with no arm/model/family/fault label or aggregate result.
blind_review.second_review: A fresh independent review covers every unique packet linked to a fault input, plus a deterministic preselected 20% of remaining unique packets. Resolve all disagreements before unblinding; preserve both initial reports. Report actual overlap and review agreement, not presumed human reliability.
blind_review.reference_defects: Resolve reference defects under blinded adjudication before arm aggregation; apply to every arm, preserve original hashes, and disclose. Do not retrain or tune from test output.
blind_review.limits: Reviewers are models; synthetic authoring and review can share blind spots.

required_before_training: compiled manifest and all three splits
required_before_collection: final v2 adapter hash and passed training/save-reload evidence

reviewed_protocol_snapshot.publication: Publish the measured comparison, failures, limitations, methods and consistent evidence downloads to the existing research site and mirror. Keep the previous pilot and original judgments accessible.

checks.definition: Mean across the 40 families of (v1 missing active units - v2 missing active units) / that family's active reference units over five decisions.
checks.implementation: legacy.score_packet increments omitted_active_units only when active reference meaning is missing. aggregate sums within family and divides paired count differences by the same active_units denominator.
checks.limits: Missing-concept omission alone does not detect wrong qualifiers, owner or lifecycle status. Those errors are separate companion measures and full correctness is stricter.

checks.definition: Mean across families of (v2 fully correct corrupted targets - v1 fully correct corrupted targets) / two targets.
checks.implementation: Fault mapping selects repair_reference_id; correctness requires equivalent meaning and Boolean true for owner/status. The check is not restricted to active references.
checks.limits: This is full correctness of the intentionally corrupted target after the attempted patch, not proof that the entire state or all other requirements are correct. Source correctness is separately reported.

checks.implementation: interval resamples the 40 paired family differences with replacement 10,000 times using seed 20261024; it does not bootstrap 200 correlated decisions as independent.
checks.interpretation: Sorted zero-based percentile indices match the prospectively chosen convention. Two 97.5% two-sided per-endpoint intervals provide an approximate conservative Bonferroni simultaneous-coverage rule for the two primary contrasts. A joint positive claim requires both lower bounds > 0.
checks.limits: Percentile coverage is approximate at 40 curated families. It captures resampling variation conditional on these labels/adapters, not label uncertainty, training-seed variability, or a representative real-world population. Shared templates may reduce the effective diversity.

checks.implementation: Only v1-to-v2 is marked primary. Base-to-v2 and base-to-v1 are secondary descriptive comparisons, even though the code also emits intervals for them.
checks.limits: Do not search the three contrasts or language/fault subgroups for a positive interval and call it the primary result. The two-endpoint adjustment does not cover the secondary comparisons.

checks.implementation: Overall and ordinary-input full active correctness, qualifier/owner/status errors, untouched-active corruption, additions, no-change updates, uncertain promotion, withdrawals, source errors, validity and identity are available through legacy counters plus strata. Repair is split by fault kind.
checks.naming_issue: targeted_reference_full_correctness selects all canonical target operation IDs: new, revised, withdrawn/reopened and repaired references. It is not a newly-added-only metric. unchanged_active_units is an untouched-active subset, not every requirement that appeared before.
checks.required_reporting_action: Name this companion targeted (new/revised/repaired) versus untouched active requirements; do not relabel targeted as newly required. A true newly-required-versus-retained result would require separately declared lineage-aware classification.

checks.implementation: Preparation requires all 600 assignments; failed/rejected outputs are projected through actual retained state and remain in quality denominators. Costs explicitly summarize completed generations and separately count excluded failures.
checks.limits: Completed-call elapsed time is descriptive and must not be presented as total operational cost when failures/retries occur. The physical-attempt journal is needed for recovery overhead. Six arm-order permutations over 200 rows leave a remainder imbalance.

checks.basis: Same 500 example count, base, max length and optimizer recipe do not imply equal training tokens or FLOPs. Protocol explicitly requires actual token/time reporting.
checks.limits: v2 changes a combined data package: scenarios, fault density, corrected semantics and citations. With one seed and no component ablation it cannot identify which change caused an observed difference or establish average benefit over training randomness.

checks.basis: The protocol and linked audit distinguish old-training retention and old-failure-informed curriculum from new held-out evaluation. Two identified train/evaluation semantic collisions were replaced before training.
checks.limits: Old exposed-test semantics informed some new training rules; old test cannot be reused as independent evidence of new generalization. Lexical/model review cannot prove absolute absence of leakage. Fresh family IDs do not establish domain/template/mechanism separation.

checks.basis: All five decisions are separate inputs with independently compiled prior state. There is no propagation of a model's preceding prediction. Families share five-decision and mostly six-to-seven-event construction.
checks.limits: Results can support a bounded tracker-state update/repair claim on this synthetic set. They cannot establish better long-horizon tracking, deployed conversation/task success, human experience, robust role routing or multiple occupational LoRA experts.

checks.basis: Exact same input/reference and canonical candidate share one judgment. All unique packets receive initial model review; all fault-linked packets plus preselected 20% of the remaining unique packets receive another review before unblinding.
checks.limits: Model reviews are not human gold; author/reviewer shared bias remains. Reference corrections must remain blinded, apply to all arms and preserve originals. Agreement and actual reviewed overlap must be reported.

engineering_boundary: Read aggregate's sealed-review verification entrypoint and freeze bindings. This audit does not replace the separately recorded engineering tests for collector, reviewer workflow, training gate or artifact replay.
decision: No blocking error found in co-primary endpoint implementation or prospective comparison design within the stated synthetic one-step scope. Resolve/report the targeted-versus-newly-required name precisely; retain all listed limitations regardless of outcome.
future_rebinding: A protocol status/review-metadata-only change may be rebound by root with the reviewed snapshot retained. Any endpoint, contrast, decision rule or data change needs explicit re-review; evaluator changes are not silently covered by this SHA-bound audit.
